title: Postinstall hook climbs one directory and appends a loader to every sibling package
intent: Model local propagation that never names node_modules or a parent-escape literal: a root-level install script takes path.dirname(__dirname), which is the directory its dependencies are unpacked into, and walks it. Only evaluating the destination path (rather than matching an install-root literal) connects the write to the install root. Inert fixture; the target is a fixture path, not a real tree.
